title: Histological, functional, and behavioral comparison of three Duchenne muscular dystrophy mouse models.
snippet: Mouse models carrying specific subsets of mutations are particularly suitable for personalized medicine research. Nonetheless, mouse models do not completely mimic the human phenotype.
